fields.label: Ca Pool
fields.help: A CA pool resource used to issue interception certificates.

fields.label: Custom TLS Features
fields.help: List of custom TLS cipher suites selected.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Exclude Public Ca Set
fields.help: If FALSE (the default), use our default set of public CAs in addition to any CAs specified in trustConfig.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location of the tls inspection policy.

fields.label: Min TLS Version
fields.help: Minimum TLS version that the firewall should use when negotiating connections with both clients and servers.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Short name of the TlsInspectionPolicy resource to be created.

fields.label: Trust Config
fields.help: A TrustConfig resource used when making a connection to the TLS server.
